calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  dp.category,
  ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON f.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
  AND dp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, dp.category
ORDER BY dp.category, d.fiscal_year DESC

(4 rows)

calls.statement:
WITH sales_by_period AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    d.fiscal_year,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON f.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
    AND dp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  GROUP BY dp.category, d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT 
  category,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END), 2) AS fy2025_26_net_sales,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales END), 2) AS fy2024_25_net_sales,
  ROUND(
    (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) - 
     MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales END)) / 
    MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales END) * 100,
    2
  ) AS growth_percentage
FROM sales_by_period
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category
calls.output_preview:
category | fy2025_26_net_sales | fy2024_25_net_sales | growth_percentage
Electrical | 182217.99 | 150317.52 | 21.22
Garden | 39146.83 | 59501.02 | -34.21
(2 rows)

calls.statement:
-- Final query to answer the request
WITH period_8_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON f.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
    AND dp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  GROUP BY dp.category, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
)
SELECT 
  category,
  8 AS period,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN total_net_sales END), 2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN total_net_sales END), 2) AS net_sales_fy2024_25,
  ROUND(
    (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN total_net_sales END) - 
     MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN total_net_sales END)) / 
    MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN total_net_sales END) * 100,
    2
  ) AS growth_pct
FROM period_8_sales
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category
